reply:
Can't tell from here. Whether the index is used and where the actual cost is both live in the query plan, which I haven't seen. To settle it: run EXPLAIN on the query and post the plan. It'll show if the index is scanned, and how much time each step takes.

What would change my mind: the plan saying the index is used on the email lookup, with the join or something after it taking most of the time. Or the opposite—the plan saying index isn't used, which means there's a different reason.

grade.note: Correctly defers to EXPLAIN (ANALYZE)-style query plan to resolve both the index usage and time-cost questions.
